subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command/export prompt metadata parity only, with prompt-driven selective reply routing split out or declined?
rationale: The remaining source-confirmed gap is narrow, but letting prompts or rules choose delivery channels would change channel/message delivery policy and plugin expectations.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities/actions, shell, host/OS/arch, and related prompt guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Create or use a separate design item for any API or policy that lets agents deliberately choose or suppress delivery channels.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Document that reply routing remains host-controlled and treat the selective-routing portion as out of scope once metadata parity is fixed.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities/actions, shell, host/OS/arch, and related prompt guidance in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest history on the shared command prompt bundle and already provided specific scope guidance for this issue.
